text: Choose company timing and location without losing individual grant eligibility
description: HUMAN DECISION REQUIRED. Do not incorporate merely because older grant notes said every route requires a company. Prototype Fund is an individual route and companies cannot receive that grant; EXIST also normally supports a pre-incorporation university-linked team. Company programs differ by registered location: Pro FIT requires a young Berlin company, while BayTOU requires a Bavarian formation/young company. Before signing: confirm Prototype Fund and possible EXIST compatibility, decide Berlin versus Bavaria from the actual operating plan rather than one grant, confirm Robin's role and ownership, and obtain German legal/tax advice. Then use meta/applications/incorporation-quickstart.md as a checklist, updating its older Berlin assumptions first.

status.comment: Felix must decide timing, Berlin versus Bavaria, ownership/Robin's role, and obtain legal/tax advice after checking individual-grant compatibility.
